submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE independent animation frame, frame 4/16 of mountain guardian boy jogging RIGHT/EAST, on true transparent background. Image 1 is edit target: KEEP exact head, hair, chest, hands, weapon/arm positions, torso silhouette, camera, full-canvas framing and character scale. Image 2 is same-direction ground-contact reference and correct boot drawing, not a replacement pose. Image 3 identity, image 4 direction/gear, image 5 approved painting style only. Edit legs, hips and boot pose physically; no whole-character shift or resizing.
Required new leg pose: second central-support pose, body passes over that same planted foot; knee softly flexed, heel and toe both down. Opposite knee swings forward but its foot stays airborne. The sole which remains grounded throughout this half-cycle belongs to anatomical RIGHT, near-camera leg. Maintain identity of this support leg as it passes from front to underneath to rear. Its floor-contact boot center should be about x=690 on normalized 1024 square, sole/contact y=965, preserving original camera and upperbody. This is position 2 of four positions, each held by two DISTINCT evolving poses. Feet migrate along travel axis, NOT sideways. Both boot long axes point right in strict profile, no sole facing camera, no duck toes or ankle inversion. Keep knee-ankle-toe mechanically aligned with natural bends. Opposite leg swings smoothly, its shoe clear from floor. Do not float the support foot or change support prematurely.
Preserve brown ponytail with green ribbon, gold green armor, wood beads, ivory pants, brown gold boots, anatomically RIGHT hand full-length gold staff and LEFT arm round shield, all digits and ornaments. Small jade ring hole transparent. No ground graphic, shadow blob, text, labels, extra limbs, duplicate feet, or effects. Detailed polished Q-style painting matched to refs. Return full-body single square image at native at least1024. Target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst / max; host manages unavailable selectors.
